titlestmt.titleproper: A Guide to the David Rockefeller papers, Correspondence FA1748

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Consists of correspondence, interviews, transcripts for interviews conducted in preparation for David Rockefeller's Memoirs, documentation of speeches, travel, and other office files. The collection also contains documentation of a selection of David Rockefeller's philanthropic activities, as well as his activities with the Council on Foreign Relations, the New York City Partnership, the Trilateral Commission, and other collaborative entities.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research in accordance with the terms of donation from the David Rockefeller Estate, January 2019. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Records are intellectually arranged in series by file type or subject/topic.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Some records remain in original housing. Additional processing may be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
